data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure: Attractions tab, search or select a destination, pick a date, click Search, then open the attraction heading. It adds a category-browsing branch and optional availability steps, and it omits guests, so the spec is somewhat vague and branching, though still mostly automatable.
